title: Who Am I?
simplified_paragraphs: 妹妹从小得了一种很奇怪的病，最多只能记住四个人。看着妹妹一天天长大，哥哥对她说:“如果你有了喜欢的人，就把我忘了吧。照顾好爸爸妈妈。”
有一天，哥哥接到一个电话，妹妹哭着问:“哥哥，我是谁啊？”哥哥听了感动得说不出话来，因为妹妹宁愿忘了自己，也不愿意忘了自己最爱的家人。
traditional_paragraphs: 妹妹從小得了一種很奇怪的病，最多只能記住四個人。看著妹妹一天天長大，哥哥對她說:“如果你有了喜歡的人，就把我忘了吧。照顧好爸爸媽媽。”
有一天，哥哥接到一個電話，妹妹哭著問:“哥哥，我是誰啊？”哥哥聽了感動得說不出話來，因為妹妹寧願忘了自己，也不願意忘了自己最愛的家人。
pinyin_paragraphs: mèi mei cóng xiǎo dé le yī zhǒng hěn qí guài de bìng， zuì duō zhǐ néng jì zhu sì gè rén。 kàn zhe mèi mei yī tiān tiān zhǎng dà， gē ge duì tā shuō :“ rú guǒ nǐ yǒu le xǐ huan de rén， jiù bǎ wǒ wàng le ba。 zhào gù hǎo bà ba mā ma。”

yǒu yì tiān， gē ge jiē dào yī gè diàn huà， mèi mei kū zhe wèn :“ gē ge， wǒ shì shéi a？” gē ge tīng le gǎn dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái， yīn wèi mèi mei nìng yuàn wàng le zì jǐ， yě bù yuàn yì wàng le zì jǐ zuì ài de jiā rén。
english_paragraphs: Ever since she was little, the younger sister had had a strange illness: she could remember no more than four people. As he watched her grow up, her older brother told her, “If you meet someone you love, forget me instead. Just take good care of Mom and Dad.”

One day, her brother got a phone call. His sister was crying. “Brother, who am I?” she asked. He was so moved that he couldn’t speak. She would rather forget herself than forget the family she loved most.
english_full:
Ever since she was little, the younger sister had had a strange illness: she could remember no more than four people. As he watched her grow up, her older brother told her, “If you meet someone you love, forget me instead. Just take good care of Mom and Dad.”

One day, her brother got a phone call. His sister was crying. “Brother, who am I?” she asked. He was so moved that he couldn’t speak. She would rather forget herself than forget the family she loved most.
